```{r}
#1a
library(tidyverse)
url<-"https://phuongov.github.io/stats506-f26/data_f26/nzge.rds"
nzge<-readRDS(base::url(url))
glimpse(nzge)


q1<-nzge%>%
  group_by(election_year,voting_type)%>%
  summarise(
    total_votes=sum(votes,na.rm=TRUE),
    .groups="drop"
  )%>%
  arrange(desc(total_votes))
print(q1)
#1b
q2<-nzge%>%
  filter(
    election_year==2014,
    voting_type=="Candidate",
    party!="Informal Candidate Votes"
  )%>%
  group_by(party)%>%
  summarise(
    total_votes=sum(votes,na.rm=TRUE),
    .groups="drop"
  )%>%
  mutate(proportion=total_votes/sum(total_votes))%>%
  arrange(desc(proportion))%>%
  mutate(
    percent=round(proportion*100,2),
    proportion=round(proportion,4)
  )
print(q2,n=Inf)
#1c
q3<-nzge%>%
  filter(!str_detect(party,"^Informal "))%>%
  group_by(election_year,voting_type,party)%>%
  summarise(
    total_votes=sum(votes,na.rm=TRUE),
    .groups="drop"
  )%>%
  group_by(election_year,voting_type)%>%
  slice_max(total_votes,n=1,with_ties=FALSE)%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  select(election_year,voting_type,party)%>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from=voting_type,
    values_from=party
  )%>%
  arrange(election_year)
print(q3)
```

```{r}
#2a
url<-"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azhou5849/tennis-atp-sackmann-data/master/atp_matches_2019.csv"
tennis<-read_csv(url,show_col_types=FALSE)
glimpse(tennis)


atp<-tennis%>%
  filter(
    tourney_level!="D",
    !tourney_name%in%c("Laver Cup","NextGen Finals")
  )
q1<-atp%>%
  summarise(tournaments=n_distinct(tourney_id))
print(q1)
#2b
champions<-atp%>%
  filter(round=="F")%>%
  distinct(tourney_id,winner_id,winner_name)
titles<-champions%>%
  count(winner_id,winner_name,name="titles")%>%
  arrange(desc(titles))
multiple_winners<-titles%>%
  filter(titles>1)
print(multiple_winners)


multiple_winners%>%
  summarise(
    players=n(),
    max_titles=max(titles)
  )
titles%>%
  slice_max(titles,n=1,with_ties=TRUE)
#2c
ace_data<-atp%>%
  filter(!is.na(w_ace),!is.na(l_ace))%>%
  mutate(ace_diff=w_ace-l_ace)


q3<-ace_data%>%
  summarise(
    matches=n(),
    winner_avg=mean(w_ace),
    loser_avg=mean(l_ace),
    mean_diff=mean(ace_diff),
    winner_more_pct=100*mean(ace_diff>0),
    loser_more_pct=100*mean(ace_diff<0),
    equal_pct=100*mean(ace_diff==0)
  )%>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric),~round(.x,2)))
print(q3)
q3%>%
  mutate(
    answer=paste0(
      "Winners averaged ",winner_avg,
      " aces per match, compared with ",
      loser_avg," for losers. ",
      "The mean difference was ",mean_diff,
      " aces. Winners hit more aces in ",
      winner_more_pct,"% of matches."
    )
  )%>%
  pull(answer)%>%
  cat()
#2d
player_matches<-bind_rows(
  atp%>%
    transmute(
      player_id=winner_id,
      player=winner_name,
      won=1
    ),
  atp%>%
    transmute(
      player_id=loser_id,
      player=loser_name,
      won=0
    )
)


player_rates<-player_matches%>%
  group_by(player_id,player)%>%
  summarise(
    matches=n(),
    wins=sum(won),
    losses=matches-wins,
    win_rate=wins/matches,
    .groups="drop"
  )%>%
  filter(matches>=5)%>%
  arrange(desc(win_rate))


q4<-player_rates%>%
  slice_max(win_rate,n=1,with_ties=TRUE)%>%
  mutate(win_rate_pct=round(100*win_rate,2))%>%
  select(player,matches,wins,losses,win_rate_pct)
print(q4)
```

```{r}
#asked chatgpt about the parameters in making a good graph
#3a
library(scales)
library(slider)
library(ggrepel)


url<-"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nytimes/covid-19-data/refs/heads/master/rolling-averages/us-states.csv"
covid<-read_csv(url,show_col_types=FALSE)%>%
  mutate(date=as.Date(date))


theme_pub<-theme_minimal(base_size=12)+
  theme(
    plot.title=element_text(face="bold",size=15),
    plot.subtitle=element_text(size=10,color="grey35"),
    plot.caption=element_text(size=9,color="grey45"),
    panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x=element_blank(),
    legend.position="top",
    plot.title.position="plot",
    plot.margin=margin(12,18,10,12)
  )


national<-covid%>%
  group_by(date)%>%
  summarise(daily_avg=sum(cases_avg,na.rm=TRUE),.groups="drop")%>%
  arrange(date)%>%
  mutate(local_max=slide_dbl(daily_avg,max,.before=60,.after=60))


peaks<-national%>%
  filter(daily_avg==local_max,daily_avg>=25000)%>%
  mutate(
    gap=as.integer(date-lag(date)),
    run=cumsum(is.na(gap)|gap>1)
  )%>%
  group_by(run)%>%
  slice_head(n=1)%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(type=if_else(daily_avg>=150000,"Major","Minor"))%>%
  select(date,daily_avg,type)


invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME","C"))
p1<-ggplot(national,aes(date,daily_avg))+
  geom_area(fill="#DFE9F1")+
  geom_line(color="#274D68",linewidth=0.8)+
  geom_point(data=peaks,aes(color=type),size=3)+
  geom_text(
    data=peaks,
    aes(label=format(date,"%b %Y"),color=type),
    vjust=-1,
    size=3,
    check_overlap=TRUE,
    show.legend=FALSE
  )+
  scale_color_manual(values=c(Major="#AC413B",Minor="#2579A0"))+
  scale_x_date(date_breaks="6 months",date_labels="%b %Y")+
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels=label_number(scale=1e-3,suffix="k"),
    expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0.15))
  )+
  labs(
    title="Major and Minor COVID-19 Spikes in the U.S.",
    x=NULL,
    y="Daily New Cases",
    color="Spike Type",
    caption="Major: >=150,000 cases/day; Minor: 25,000–149,999 cases/day\nSource: The New York Times COVID-19 Data"
  )+
  theme_pub
print(p1)
#3b
state_rates<-covid%>%
  filter(state%in%state.name)%>%
  group_by(state)%>%
  summarise(
    overall_rate=sum(cases_avg_per_100k,na.rm=TRUE),
    .groups="drop"
  )%>%
  arrange(desc(overall_rate))


extremes<-bind_rows(
  state_rates%>%
    slice_head(n=1)%>%
    mutate(group="Highest overall rate"),
  state_rates%>%
    slice_tail(n=1)%>%
    mutate(group="Lowest overall rate")
)
trajectory<-covid%>%
  inner_join(extremes,by="state")%>%
  mutate(panel=paste0(group,": ",state))


p2<-ggplot(trajectory,aes(date,cases_avg_per_100k))+
  geom_area(fill="#CFDFEB",alpha=0.85)+
  geom_line(color="#23668E",linewidth=0.7)+
  facet_wrap(~panel,ncol=1,scales="fixed")+
  scale_x_date(date_breaks="6 months",date_labels="%b %Y")+
  scale_y_continuous(labels=label_number(accuracy=1))+
  labs(
    title="COVID-19 Trajectories: Highest vs. Lowest Cumulative Case Rates",
    subtitle="Daily new cases per 100,000 people (7-day rolling average)",
    x=NULL,
    y="Daily New Cases per 100,000",
    caption="Source: The New York Times COVID-19 Data"
  )+
  theme_pub+
  theme(strip.text=element_text(face="bold",hjust=0))
print(p2)
#3c
#asked chatgpt about a NA problem while making the ggplot graph
onsets<-covid%>%
  filter(state%in%state.name)%>%
  arrange(state,date)%>%
  group_by(state)%>%
  mutate(
    sustained=slide_lgl(
      cases_avg_per_100k,
      ~all(.x>=1),
      .after=6,
      .complete=TRUE
    )
  )%>%
  filter(sustained)%>%
  summarise(onset=min(date),.groups="drop")%>%
  arrange(onset,state)
first_five<-onsets%>%
  slice_head(n=5)


early_states<-onsets%>%
  slice_head(n=15)%>%
  mutate(group=if_else(row_number()<=5,"First five","Next ten"))
start_date<-min(early_states$onset)-7
end_date<-max(early_states$onset)+20


plot_data<-covid%>%
  filter(date>=start_date,date<=end_date)%>%
  inner_join(early_states,by="state")%>%
  mutate(
    state=factor(state,levels=rev(early_states$state)),
    status=case_when(
      is.na(cases_avg_per_100k)~"No data",
      cases_avg_per_100k>=1~"At/above 1",
      TRUE~"Below 1"
    )
  )
marks<-early_states%>%
  mutate(state=factor(state,levels=rev(early_states$state)))


p3<-ggplot(plot_data,aes(date,state))+
  geom_tile(
    aes(fill=status),
    width=1,
    height=0.75
  )+
  geom_segment(
    data=marks,
    aes(x=onset,xend=onset+6,y=state,yend=state,color=group),
    linewidth=2,
    inherit.aes=FALSE
  )+
  geom_point(
    data=marks,
    aes(x=onset,y=state,color=group),
    size=2.8,
    inherit.aes=FALSE
  )+
  geom_label(
    data=marks%>%filter(group=="First five"),
    aes(x=onset+9,y=state,label=format(onset,"%b %d")),
    size=2.7,
    fill="white",
    color="#AC413B",
    inherit.aes=FALSE
  )+
  scale_fill_manual(
    values=c(
      "Below 1"="#E9EEF2",
      "At/above 1"="#3B809E",
      "No data"="#FFFFFF"
    ),
    name="Daily case rate"
  )+
  scale_color_manual(
    values=c("First five"="#AC413B","Next ten"="#61737D"),
    name="Onset group"
  )+
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks="1 week",
    date_labels="%b %d"
  )+
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim=c(start_date-1,end_date+1)
  )+
  labs(
    title="The Earliest States to Experience Sustained COVID-19 Activity",
    subtitle="First 15 states to sustain at least 1 daily case per 100,000 for 7 days",
    x="Date (2020)",
    y=NULL,
    caption="Colored segments mark the first qualifying 7-day periods.\nSource: The New York Times COVID-19 Data"
  )+
  theme_pub+
  theme(
    panel.grid=element_blank(),
    axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1),
    legend.position="bottom"
  )
print(p3)
```
